Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Fireside Girls.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (cont'd) Let's welcome another day for us to be chipper, cooperative, and cheer in unison!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: As you all know, the annual Fireside Cupcake Jamboree is coming up, and we have a big decision to make—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (cont'd, offscreen) Picking the cupcake flavor to bring.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (cont'd) Ms. Feyerseid will be here soon to guide the proceedings—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, hi, Ms. Feyerseid. (frowning) You won't make it in today...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (cont'd, offscreen) I guess I can run the meeting.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'll just follow the Fireside Handbook. Feel better! Bye!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So I guess we'll go ahead and start! (flipping through the handbook) Our trusty Fireside Handbook has some guidelines to follow, starting with the compliment session.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (to Holly) You are worthy of every patch you've earned.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (to Katie) You always inspire me to get one percent better.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (to Isabella) You have natural charm and leadership ability.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to, uh, ping your pong, Agent P, but we've received word that Doofenshmirtz has made an appointment to renew his evil business license.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (cont'd) And the only thing worse than regular evil is unlicensed evil. So make sure he does the proper paperwork.

Name: Carl
Dialog: That reminds me, sir. O.W.C.A.'s business license expired last month!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There's nothing wrong with unlicensed good, Carl. (turning to Perry) Oh, uh, since you're in the area, Carl would appreciate it if you renewed our license too.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I think it's cupcake time!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Cupcakes are life!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Cupcake time!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So it says here we should vote on our preferred cupcake flavor. That should be super easy.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Vanilla!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Vanilla!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Vanilla!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (dramatically) Red velvet.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: What? I like red velvet.

Name: Katie
Dialog: I like red velvet!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: So what do we do now, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh! Um, well, eh... It says here, "In the incredibly unlikely event of a tie vote, just vote again." Hmm. All in favor of vanilla, raise your hand.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All in favor of red velvet?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hmm. I don't remember a single time we didn't unanimously pick the same thing, then rejoice in a harmonized shriek.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Hmm. A split decision. (eyebrow raising) Now what?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is a situation the Fireside Girls have never had to deal with.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! Walk and talk, my nimble friend, walk and talk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have to renew my evil business license at Danville's Embassy for Evil today. You can come along in case I need someone to vouch for my evilness, which I think—I think you can do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shoo, shoo! Go find your own inator to put your gross pigeon feet on! (walking away) Have you seen pigeon feet? Well, don't start now, trust me. You can't unsee them. (sing-songy) Disgusting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's the trap I was gonna use on you, but my evil license expired as we previously established, and I don't wanna pay all those fines.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (clears throat) Adyson, you were the first to earn a Cupcake Delivery patch. How about you deliver your trash to the trash can?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (under breath) Or maybe you should get a Shut Your Cakehole patch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Excuse me?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Nothing.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Maybe we should try giving the cupcake flavor another vote.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: What if we did donuts?

Name: Girls
Dialog: Hooray! / Donuts! / I love dunkable snacks!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, ladies. I think we should stick to cupcakes. Let's just pick one. Red velvet or vanilla?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: How about neither? Let's pick a new flavor.

Name: Girls
Dialog: Why not donuts? / I'll never back down from the donuts! / Yeah, why not donuts? / I like new things! / I have no agency!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (firm) Girls, stop!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm sorry. (chuckles nervously) Let's just, um... (picks up the handbook) Okay. Here's an idea from the "One of those days" section. Let's all hold hands and sing a jovial song.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (cont'd) In D major. And a-one, two, a-three—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait, what's happening? We've never gone off pitch! (consults the handbook) Is there a full moon tonight? Is Mercury in retrograde?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This should take just a minute, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Diminutive. I'd say it's nice to see you, but I'm an evil scientist, not a liar.

Name: Diminutive
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes. Enough of this awkward banter. I'm cutting in line.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Isabella, why don't you let me take over the meeting? It seems like it's too much for you.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's not too much for me, Gretchen. It's a cupcake vote. Just pick a flavor.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (pointing accusatorily) You want to put us in all these little boxes, like your stupid little vanilla cupcakes. But we just want to do whatever we want! You're not the boss of us!

Name: Girl
Dialog: Not the boss!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Not the boss.

Name: Katie
Dialog: Whatever we want!

Name: Milly
Dialog: General anger!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just vote for a flavor! Who wants vanilla?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (sarcastic) Vanilla, huh? Do you have a patch for being basic?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (angry) Well, I do have the most patches. So yes, I probably do have that basic patch! (she looks around) Um, what I mean to say is... (sighs) Let's focus, girls.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: The girls need someone to make a choice! To lead them!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (pulling Gretchen aside) Gretchen, what's going on? We're always on the same page!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (angry) I think it's time I have my own page.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (slaps Isabella's hand aside) A new page.

Name: Girls
Dialog: No! / I'm disagreeing with you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (selecting himself) Oh, hello, handsome.

Name: Kiosk
Dialog: Do you have a viable backstory?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, plenty! Plenty! (cross fade to the Doofenshmirtz family home) Back in Drusselstein, in the days of—

Name: Kiosk
Dialog: Please do not monologue into the interface.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offended) Perhaps you shouldn't have asked.

Name: Kiosk
Dialog: Please select your nemesis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (scratching head) Uh, he's more of a—a frenemy, but our—our boundaries are fluid.

Name: Examiner
Dialog: You are ready to begin your assessment. Right this way, please.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: See? Cupcakes can be donuts too! We don't have to conform to society's norms anymore!

Name: Melissa
Dialog: Non-conformity!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Cupcakes with holes!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: I taste power!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Only whoever holds the handbook should speak!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Your taste is suspect, Isabella! Who even thinks triangles are cute?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (enraged) He's more than a triangle!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (to herself) That's not like me.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: The choice is easy! Red velvet or donuts! (throws a cupcake at Isabella's feet) Pick a side!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Chocolate!

Name: Katie
Dialog: Cronuts!

Name: Milly
Dialog: Cheese plate!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Remember, girls! Cooperate! Appreciate! (ducks under a thrown log, exclaims)

Name: Holly
Dialog: (screaming) Flan!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: I love it! I love the taste! (sticks tongue out)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (panicked) You can't see us like this!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I guess girls do mature faster than boys.

Name: Examiner
Dialog: Your next assignment is scheming.  Take over this model of the Tri-State Area. Your time starts... (starts stopwatch on his phone) ...now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doof likey! Well, first, I would place a robot army right here. Wait-wait, that's a one-way street, so they would actually, I guess, be over here. Wait—this is no longer a vacuum store. They actually sell tires. (gets out a red marker and writes on the building) T-I-R-E-S. Tires. They sell tires there. Wait, and who made this model? Th-This can't be a restaurant! They're not zoned for food.

Name: Examiner
Dialog: And time's up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, that tracks, I suppose.

Name: Examiner
Dialog: Okay, we're just gonna montage through the next few tests.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cooperate, you animals!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Any more tests?

Name: Examiner
Dialog: No, you completed all the tests. But our system is down so you'll have to come back tomorrow.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, tomorrow?!

Name: Examiner
Dialog: Or you can do it online. (turns to leave)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Online? That, that was an option the whole time?! Well, ain't that a kick in the— (the rolling ball rolls him over to avoid him from completing the sentence) Ow!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Milly, we really need to add a section for this in the handbook!

Name: Milly
Dialog: This is seriously out of control! But I feel so safe with you, Isabella. Like nothing bad will ever happen— (screams as she is pulled into the chaos)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, that was difficult. It used to be so easy, just like filling out a piece of paper and dropping it off. All right, Perry the Platypus, you can do your thing now. I've got the rest of the afternoon off. Apparently.

Name: Kiosk
Dialog: Congratulations! You have renewed your good business license!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, I'm just gonna take the high road and use this as a backstory for some—

Name: Kiosk
Dialog: Please do not monologue into the interface.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I can't lie, girls. I'm tempted to join you all in the chaos. Maybe there's a patch at the end of this very dark tunnel, but for the first time, I don't know...

Name: Melissa
Dialog: (carrying an Isabella effigy) Down with Isa-smella!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (popping out of a vandalized portrait of Isabella) Down with Isa-smella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Son of a patch! (the handbook is shot to the wall, and this infuriates Isabella) That's it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait wait, why is this turned on? Shoo! Shoo, bird, shoo! (The pigeon flies away.) Huh. I hope my Uncooperate-inator didn't cause any problems in that little building over there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: ...That was...weird. What happened?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: I have no idea.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, how about red velvet... with vanilla frosting?

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: See? Everything works out when you cooperate.
